  "source": [
    "FUNCTION RPY_DYNPRO_READ_NATIVE.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(PROGNAME) LIKE  D020S-PROG",
    "*\"     VALUE(DYNNR) LIKE  D020S-DNUM",
    "*\"     VALUE(SUPPRESS_EXIST_CHECKS) TYPE  C DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(SUPPRESS_CORR_CHECKS) TYPE  C DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(HEADER) LIKE  D020S STRUCTURE  D020S",
    "*\"     VALUE(DYNPROTEXT) LIKE  D020T-DTXT",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      FIELDLIST STRUCTURE  D021S OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      FLOWLOGIC TYPE  DYN_FLOWLIST OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      PARAMS STRUCTURE  D023S OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      FIELDTEXTS STRUCTURE  D021T OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      CANCELLED",
    "*\"      NOT_FOUND",
    "*\"      PERMISSION_ERROR",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "  DYNNUMB = DYNNR.",
    "  DYNP_ID-PROG = PROGNAME.",
    "  DYNP_ID-DNUM = DYNNUMB.",
    "",
    "* Existenztest",
    "  IF SUPPRESS_EXIST_CHECKS = ' '.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM  D020S",
    "           WHERE  PROG        = PROGNAME",
    "           AND    DNUM        = DYNNUMB.",
    "    IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.",
    "      MESSAGE E004 WITH DYNP_ID RAISING NOT_FOUND.",
    "*     Objekt & nicht gefunden.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* Anzeigeberechtigung verproben",
    "  IF SUPPRESS_CORR_CHECKS = ' '.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'RS_ACCESS_PERMISSION'",
    "         EXPORTING",
    "              GLOBAL_LOCK              = SPACE",
    "              MODE                     = 'SHOW'",
    "              OBJECT                   = DYNP_ID",
    "              OBJECT_CLASS             = 'SCRP'",
    "         EXCEPTIONS",
    "              CANCELED_IN_CORR         = 01",
    "              ENQUEUED_BY_USER         = 02",
    "              ENQUEUE_SYSTEM_FAILURE   = 03",
    "              ILLEGAL_PARAMETER_VALUES = 04",
    "              LOCKED_BY_AUTHOR         = 05",
    "              NO_MODIFY_PERMISSION     = 06",
    "              NO_SHOW_PERMISSION       = 07",
    "              PERMISSION_FAILURE       = 12.",
    "    CASE SY-SUBRC.",
    "      WHEN 0.",
    "      WHEN 1.",
    "        MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE  'E'     NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                RAISING CANCELLED.",
    "      WHEN 12.",
    "        MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE  'E'     NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                RAISING PERMISSION_ERROR.",
    "      WHEN OTHERS.",
    "        MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE  'E'     NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                RAISING PERMISSION_ERROR.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* Dynpro importieren",
    "  IMPORT DYNPRO HEADER FIELDLIST FLOWLOGIC PARAMS ID DYNP_ID.",
    "  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.",
    "    MESSAGE E004 WITH DYNP_ID  RAISING NOT_FOUND.",
    "*   Objekt & nicht gefunden.",
    "    EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* upgrade auf aktuelles Niveau",
    "  call function 'RS_SCRP_UPGRADE_DYNPRO'",
    "         tables",
    "              f       = fieldlist",
    "              m       = params",
    "         changing",
    "              h       = header.",
    "",
    "* Dynprobeschreibungstext importieren",
    "  CLEAR DYNPROTEXT.",
    "  SELECT SINGLE * FROM  D020T",
    "       WHERE  PROG        = PROGNAME",
    "       AND    DYNR        = DYNNUMB",
    "       AND    LANG        = HEADER-SPRA.",
    "  DYNPROTEXT = D020T-DTXT.",
    "",
    "* dynprobezogene Feldtexte importieren",
    "  REFRESH FIELDTEXTS.",
    "  SELECT        * FROM  D021T  INTO TABLE FIELDTEXTS",
    "        WHERE  PROG        = PROGNAME",
    "        AND    DYNR        = DYNNUMB",
    "        AND    LANG        = HEADER-SPRA.",
    "",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],
